name: calvary-scribblings
//: No image/build key: keep the Codespaces default universal image (unchanged from before this file existed). This config exists only to restore deploy credentials after a rebuild — the FIREBASE_SA_KEY Codespaces secret (base64 of serviceAccountKey.json) is decoded back to the gitignored key file so `npm run rules:deploy` and the rules:pull/check scripts keep working. See RULES.md.
postCreateCommand: if [ -n "$FIREBASE_SA_KEY" ]; then echo "$FIREBASE_SA_KEY" | base64 -d > serviceAccountKey.json; fi
